research_question: Owned-page scope: MyCase Legal Software and Client Communication. Planned sources and method: MyCase official feature and pricing pages; map a sample client exchange. Build a source-labelled comparison covering MyCase client portal and MyCase pricing; record dates, definitions and sample limits. Sources are proposed, not verified findings.

research_brief.purpose: Help law firms choose a MyCase plan by mapping the client communication journey to plan features and the full published cost.
research_brief.audience: Managing partners, operations leads, and intake or client-service managers at small and mid-sized U.S. law firms evaluating MyCase.
research_brief.data_period: MyCase pricing, feature, and help-center pages as displayed on October 2, 2026 (help article dated June 1, 2026)
research_brief.scope_limitations: Desk research from public MyCase pages; no quote requested and no hands-on trial performed. LawPay processing rates are not published on the pricing page and are not estimated. Calculations are illustrative arithmetic on published rates.

statistics.claim: MyCase lists Basic at $50, Pro at $100, and Advanced at $130 per user per month billed annually; $60, $120, and $150 billed monthly.
MyCase Accounting is a $39 per user per month add-on.
statistics.limitations: Applies per user who needs access.

statistics.claim: Ten Pro users cost $12,000 per year on annual billing and $14,400 on monthly billing.
statistics.method: Verdict Point arithmetic on list prices

statistics.claim: Firms are never charged for clients and contacts given client portal access.
statistics.limitations: Licensing statement; confirm in the quote.

content_gaps: No ranking page compares client communication features plan by plan.
Several pages show outdated prices or only monthly rates.
No page models the accounting add-on or billing-term cost difference for a real team size.
Cancellation and refund terms are missing from every competitor reviewed.
value_add: A client-journey map tied to plan features, current annual and monthly prices with a 10-user cost model, the accounting add-on, licensing and cancellation terms from MyCase's own documentation, and a trial acceptance checklist.
